name: Comments
description: Represents a collection of Comment objects.
example:
Sub CountComments()
    MsgBox "You have " & ActiveWindow.Selection.SlideRange(1) _
        .Comments.Count & " comments on this slide."
End Sub

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Comment object from the specified Comments collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single Comment object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add2
methods.signature: Add2(Left As Single, Top As Single, Author As String, AuthorInitials As String, Text As String, ProviderID As String, UserID As String) As Comment
methods.description: Replaces hidden Add method. Returns a Comment object that represents a new comment added to a slide. For more infomation about modern comments, see Modern comments in PowerPoint.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the comment, relative to the left edge of the presentation.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the comment, relative to the top edge of the presentation.

parameters.name: ProviderID
parameters.description: The service that provides contact information.Example: "AD" (Active Directory)

parameters.name: UserID
parameters.description: The ID of the user providing the comment.
